identificationModule.briefTitle: Open Label Two-Arm Study to Evaluate Rilzabrutinib in IgG4-Related Disease Participants
identificationModule.officialTitle: An Open Label, Two-Arm Study to Evaluate the Effect of Rilzabrutinib (PRN1008/SAR444671) on Safety and Disease Activity in ParticipantsWith IgG4-Related Disease

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a Phase 2a, multi-center, open-label, two-arm study of approximately 25 patients with active IgG4-related disease (IgG4-RD). The two arms include (1) Experimental: rilzabrutinib with glucocorticoids and (2) Active Comparator: glucocorticoids only.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: 4 weeks of screening, 12 weeks of main treatment, 12 weeks of cross-over (for GC-only group), 40 weeks of extension treatment and 4-week follow-up.

armGroups.label: Rilzabrutinib + glucocorticoids
armGroups.description: Rilzabrutinib tablets, 400 mg twice daily from Week 0 to Week 12 plus glucocorticoids (20 to 40 mg/day prednisone equivalent tapered to 0 mg/day within 2 weeks on study)

armGroups.label: Glucocorticoids
armGroups.description: Glucocorticoids (20 to 40 mg/day prednisone equivalent tapered to 0 mg/day within 12 weeks on study)

primaryOutcomes.measure: Proportion of participants who are without disease flare following the first dose of rilzabrutinib until the end of treatment
primaryOutcomes.description: Disease flare is defined as an increase in IgG4-RD responder index (RI) \>2 or initiation of rescue treatment.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Incidence of SAE, AE leading to discontinuation and possible glucocorticoid-related AE
Number of participants with Potentially clinically significant abnormalities (PCSAs) for clinical laboratory tests, vital signs and ECG

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Proportion of participants with reduction from baseline IgG4-RD RI activity score by ≥2 points over time
Proportion of patients with an IgG4-RD RI activity score = 0 at over time
Level and change from baseline of each subclass of the serological markers over time
secondaryOutcomes.description: serum protein electrophoresis to determine IgG subclasses and complement factors C3 and C4

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Proportion of participants achieving reduction in baseline serum IgG4 level of 10% over time
Change from baseline in IgG4-RD RI over time
Change from baseline in IgG4-RD damage, as recorded on the damage portion of the IgG4-RD RI over time

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Key Inclusion Criteria:

* Be male or female with age ≥18 years.
* Have a clinical diagnosis of IgG4-RD.
* Be willing to taper off an equivalent prednisone dose of between 20-40 mg/day in 2 weeks.

Key Exclusion Criteria:

* Currently or within 6 months of screening taking rituximab, other B-cell depleting agents, or alkylating agents unless B cell concentrations have been demonstrated by flow cytometry to return to normal values (defined as 5 cells per cubic mm).
* History of solid organ transplant
* Positive at Screening for HIV, hepatitis B, hepatitis C, or TB
* Female patients who are pregnant or nursing.
* NOTE: Other Inclusion/Exclusion criteria may apply.
